notes: Canonical spoken text for every packaged voice asset. Facts must match approved.json; numbers are written in spoken form so Fish Speech pronounces them reliably. 'keywords' are words the ASR transcript must contain for the asset to pass validation.

greeting.text: Thank you for calling Mouth Care Solutions. How may I help you today?

outbound_greeting.text: Hello, this is the Mouth Care Solutions AI receptionist. How may I help you today?

clinic_hours.text: Our clinic is open Monday to Saturday, from ten in the morning to eight in the evening. We are closed on Sundays.

clinic_address.text: We are located at door number twenty nine, twenty eight, twenty three, Bhavani Complex, Suryaraopeta, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh.

clinic_phone.text: You can reach Mouth Care Solutions at plus nine one, nine six four two three, four zero six three zero.

clinic_email.text: Our email address is mouth care solutions, all one word, at gmail dot com.

services.text: We provide preventive, restorative, cosmetic, orthodontic, endodontic, prosthodontic, pediatric, oral surgery, and emergency dental care.

emergency_care.text: If there is severe pain, uncontrolled bleeding, facial swelling affecting breathing or swallowing, or a dental injury, seek urgent medical care. This receptionist cannot diagnose.

appointment_request.text: I can help you request an appointment. What date would you prefer?

ask_preferred_time.text: What time would work best for you?

ask_patient_name.text: May I have the patient's name, please?

ask_reason_for_visit.text: What is the reason for your visit?

confirm_appointment.text: Would you like me to send this appointment request to the clinic team? Please say yes or no.

appointment_recorded.text: Thank you. Your appointment request has been noted. The clinic team will call you to confirm the date and time.

appointment_declined.text: No problem. I have not sent the request.

unsupported_question.text: I'm sorry, I don't have approved information about that. I will ask the clinic team to call you back.

callback_noted.text: Of course. I will ask the clinic team to call you back.

anything_else.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

repeat_or_not_understood.text: I'm sorry, I did not quite catch that. Could you please say it again?

generic_help.text: I can help with clinic hours, our address, our services, emergencies, or an appointment request. What would you like to know?

goodbye.text: Thank you for speaking with Mouth Care Solutions. Goodbye.

opt_out_confirmed.text: Understood. We will not call this number again. Goodbye.

technical_issue.text: I am sorry, we are having a temporary technical issue. Please try again shortly.

lines_busy.text: I am sorry, all of our lines are busy right now. Please call again in a few minutes.
